scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 64 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

places-petite-villa-au-bord-du-lac-leman.story: 275 km from Vevey to Vevey, about 4 h 44 of riding. On the way it passes Les Roseaux, Littoral de Chens-sur-Léman, Le Grand Lac de Clairvaux and back through Littoral de Chens-sur-Léman. The highest point is about 1,250 m. It crosses from Switzerland into France - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
